def bisect_left(arr, x):
    """
    x = 5
          L      R
      1 3 4      10 10
   arr[i] <5 |   5 <= arr[i]


   x = 2
      L              R
      1              3 4 10 10
   arr[0..L] < 2 |   2 <= arr[R..N]
    """
    N = len(arr)
    l = -1  # arr[l] <  x
    r = N   # arr[r] >= x
    while r > l + 1:
        m = (l + r) // 2
        if arr[m] < x:
            l = m
        else:
            r = m
    return l
